close_reason: Already addressed as part of PKIX-qwzx.2 fix in same README block.
description:
README.md line 81:
  let crl_checker = CrlChecker::new(crl_der_bytes, now_unix, DefaultVerifier);
  let validated = verify_chain_default(&chain, &anchors, &policy, &crl_checker)?;

After P3 commit ff707564 (PKIX-xjbw, 'parse CRL/OCSP once at construction; CrlChecker/OcspChecker::new return Result'), the type of `crl_checker` is now `Result<CrlChecker<DefaultVerifier>, Error>`, not `CrlChecker<...>`. The example would fail with a type error at the `&crl_checker` argument.

Fix: `let crl_checker = CrlChecker::new(crl_der_bytes, now_unix, DefaultVerifier)?;`

Severity: P3 because this is part of the same README block flagged at P2 in PKIX-qwzx.2; one PR can fix both.

Pass-1 attribution: a side effect of PKIX-xjbw — the README wasn't updated when the API changed.
title: P3: README.md CRL example uses pre-P3 CrlChecker::new signature (now returns Result)
